summary_1line: Bharata refuses the throne, declares Rama the rightful king, and resolves to go to the forest to bring him back for coronation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Prince Shatrughna drags Manthara across the palace floor, her scattered ornaments glittering like stars across the hall.
Bharata solemnly circumambulates the royal coronation articles while ministers watch, declaring that Rama alone deserves the throne.
The gathered court and citizens weep with joy as Bharata announces he will march to the forest to bring Rama back as king.
